text:
marta: quick proposal: "echo-run" mode for runtime config applies. apply to a tiny shadow cohort, stream telemetry snapshots, auto-revert on bad signals. want to sketch console flow before RFC.

sam: sounds promising. what exactly do you mean by telemetry snapshot?

marta: structured audit event with fields: config_id, actor, diff, cohort_pct, ttl, snapshot_id, trigger_type. queryable from config timeline.

deen: threshold idea: auto-revert if 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline OR p95 latency increases by 30% sustained over 5m. need cooldown to avoid flapping.

ops-bot: infra-bot: reminder: auto-revert actions must include operator id and correlation id for postmortem traces.

jules: console UX: show an active echo panel next to the change with live sparkline, progress, and actions: Pause / Force-Revert / Extend. Pause stops further cohort expansion but keeps monitoring.

ash: shadow traffic could consume quota for Dedicated customers; we should support routing to an isolated cheap pool or do request-replay simulation. add "charge_shadow" flag.

marta: proposed default: charge_shadow=false. routing choices: replay|isolated. console toggle: "Bill shadow traffic".

lina-pm: acceptance criteria: UI shows audit event + live metrics; auto-revert triggers within 2m of threshold; per-change opt-out for auto-revert; shadow traffic does not affect customer quotas by default.

sam: backend: new ConfigApply state machine: PENDING -> ECHO_RUNNING -> ECHO_FAILED -> APPLIED. emit snapshot_id at echo start and deltas afterwards. tag rollout metrics with echo_run=true.

deen: reuse quota-exempt header? propose X-Shadow-Mode: replay|isolated. proxies need to honor; plan for graceful degradation on older proxies.

jules: UI nit: when auto-reverted, collapse the diff and show reason + link to metric snapshot; add button to re-run echo with adjusted params.

marta: API draft: 

POST /runtime/configs.apply
{
  "config_id": "route_quota_v2",
  "apply_mode": "echo",   // echo | roll | instant
  "cohort_pct": 0.5,
  "ttl_secs": 600,
  "auto_revert_policy": {"enabled": true, "error_rate_mult": 1.5, "p95_latency_pct": 1.3, "window_secs": 300},
  "charge_shadow": false
}

ops-bot: infra-note: add correlation header X-Config-Trace: cfg-<sha>-<nonce> to tie logs/traces/audit.

ash: Dedicated teams prefer replay mode that doesn't consume GPU cycles but exercises code paths. ops infra will need opt-in.

sam: owners: runtime-api (sam) for surface; telemetry (deen) for thresholds; console (jules) for UX. marta will file RFC.

marta: RFC filed: https://r.reddoc/internal/rfc/echo-run-2026. checklist: auditline schema, routing header, telemetry tags, console mocks, safe defaults, e2e smoke tests.

lina-pm: timeline: alpha (APIs + backend + basic card) in 3 sprints, then SRE integration for Dedicated quota handling.

jules: show estimated cost delta in card when charge_shadow=true so teams can make informed choice.

ash: add guard: limit to 2 concurrent echo_runs per org to avoid noisy experiments.

marta: will add to RFC. objections to prototyping this week?

deen: no objections, I'll draft proto for threshold config.

sam: I'll stub API and add lint for apply_mode values.

ash: thumbs up.

jules: adding UI task to board.

marta: thanks everyone, will update RFC and ping for review. :handshake:
